title: Orchestrate clearance pathways for Private Edition PRD
creator: Aisha Raman
description: We need a single, explicit clearance and acceptance pathway for the Private Edition PRD (customer-managed VPC + optional on-prem). The PRD introduces gated scope: model version pinning for private tenants, KMS/HSM integration for encryption-at-rest, and a staged rollout that requires legal and security sign-offs before any on-prem installs. This ticket coordinates cross-team checkpoints, defines exit criteria for each stage, and documents the dependencies and fallbacks. Trade-offs: aggressive rollout reduces time-to-value for enterprise customers but increases audit overhead; a more conservative path delays adoption but simplifies compliance. Deliverables: final signoff matrix, a checklist for SRE/Eng acceptance tests, design approval for tenant-facing controls, and completed legal data residency review.
acceptance_criteria: Signed acceptance matrix with named owners (Eng, Design, Legal, Security, PM)
Legal privacy and data residency review completed with action items closed or scheduled
Design mocks for tenant controls approved and linked in PRD
Engineering acceptance tests (integration + upgrade path) pass in staging and testnet
Rollback and fallback playbook documented and reviewed by SRE
Release gating steps and canary metrics defined (latency/cost/error thresholds)
KMS/HSM integration validated in a lab environment and key rotation runbook created
